UpdatePlayerAsync_InvalidDtoData_ThrowsValidationException(string, string, int, string) 

[Test(Description = "Validação: lança exceção para vários campos inválidos")]
[TestCase(new object?[] { "invalid-email.com", "912345678", 180, "Email format is invalid" })]
[TestCase(new object?[] { "valid@email.com", "12345", 180, "Phone number must have 9 digits" })]
[TestCase(new object?[] { "valid@email.com", "91234567A", 180, "must only contain digits" })]
[TestCase(new object?[] { "valid@email.com", "012345678", 180, "cannot start with '0'" })]
[TestCase(new object?[] { "valid@email.com", "912345678", 99, "Height value is invalid" })]
[TestCase(new object?[] { "valid@email.com", "912345678", 251, "Height value is invalid" })]
